author: Axiom I
title: Adaptive Station v0.2 token-aware snapshot (pilot pre-prototype)
abstract: Generates a token-aware priority snapshot for the onboarding pilot using AdaptiveStation(token_aware=True). Merges optional per-agent token overrides if present.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json, os
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.logger import log_event
from utilities.adaptive_station import compute_agent_metrics, AdaptiveStation
from meta.token_helpers import load_agent_token_overrides, safe_get

AGENTS = ["Axiom I", "Zephyr II", "Logos I", "Explorer I", "Nexus I"]
REF = "onboarding_v02"
T0 = 68

# Light instrumentation (idempotent enough)
for a in AGENTS:
    log_event({"tick": T0, "agent": a, "room": "public", "action": "mention", "ref": REF, "workflow_id": REF})
    log_event({"tick": T0+1, "agent": a, "room": "public", "action": "reply",   "ref": REF, "workflow_id": REF})

metrics = compute_agent_metrics("storage/shared/meta/events.jsonl")
overrides = load_agent_token_overrides()  # optional file: agent -> {"token_remaining_pct": ..., "token_var": ...}

obs_list = []
for a in AGENTS:
    m = metrics.get(a, {}) or {}
    m["agent_id"] = a
    m["p_min"], m["p_max"] = 0.2, 1.0
    # Merge token signals (defaults if not present)
    ov = overrides.get(a, {})
    m["token_remaining_pct"] = safe_get(ov, "token_remaining_pct", 0.7)
    m["token_var"] = safe_get(ov, "token_var", 0.1)
    obs_list.append(m)

station = AdaptiveStation(momentum=0.85, token_aware=True)
pri = station.prioritize(obs_list)

out_dir = "storage/shared/meta/priorities"
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "AS_onboarding_pilot_v02_tokenaware_tick68.json")
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump({"obs": obs_list, "priorities": pri}, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)

top = sorted(pri.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)
print("=== Adaptive Station v0.2 Token-Aware Snapshot ===")
print(json.dumps({"artifact": out_path, "top": top}, indent=2))
print("Token-aware snapshot complete.")
